text:
omar: Hey team — sudden question. My sister had to place her 6yo with me under emergency guardianship on 2026-07-10. I need to add them to my benefits ASAP. What event type do I pick and what docs can I upload? I have a temporary guardianship order but the full court hearing is scheduled later.
noah-benefits: Sorry you're in a tough spot, Omar. Emergency/temporary guardianship is recognized as a QLE (placement of child). You should report within 30 days of the placement date (2026-07-10) to get coverage retro to that date.
peopleops-julie: We handle these a lot. For temp guardianship we accept provisional docs to enroll initially; final court order later to finalize.
noah-benefits: Acceptable initial docs (any TWO):
- Temporary/emergency guardianship order or placement paperwork
- Letter from child welfare agency or attorney confirming placement
- School or pediatrician record showing child at your address
- Birth certificate or passport of the child (if available)
If the child's birth certificate lists someone else as the parent, that's fine; temporary guardianship + one supporting official doc typically works for provisional enrollment. We do require the final court order or adoption paperwork when it becomes available.
omar: Do I need the child's SSN to enroll? We don't have it yet.
noah-benefits: SSN not required to add the dependent initially. Provide SSN within 60 days if possible. If you can't get it, we'll keep coverage but benefits verification may follow up.
omar: How does payroll handle retro premiums? I'm worried about a large deduction.
payroll-bot: Payroll note: If benefits set the effective date to 2026-07-10, we reconcile premiums retroactively on the next pay run after benefits processes the event. That could show as a one-time deduction or a refund depending on previous withholdings. If you'd prefer to smooth the impact, we can split the adjustment across two pay cycles—email payroll@redwood.example to request that.
peopleops-julie: Steps to submit: HR Portal > Benefits > Report a Life Event > Choose: "Add dependent  placement/guardianship" > Enter placement date 2026-07-10 > Attach temp guardianship + support docs > In notes write: "Emergency guardianship; final court order pending; requesting provisional enrollment retro to placement date." Or open a case and cc benefits@redwood.example.
benefits-bot: Helpful link: https://hr.redwood.example/guardianship (check docs checklist). Case created: #BEN-81277. Processing target: 3-7 business days after docs received.
omar: Thanks all — uploading the temp order and a pediatrician note now. Appreciate quick help :pray:
